description: For a table-type, a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over F, with no data change: Move 2, read BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition (not table-type) and ID; Requery; read the same, RecordCount, MoveNext and read, MovePrevious and read; MoveLast, MoveNext (EOF), Requery, read; MoveFirst, MovePrevious (BOF), Requery, read; Requery again; Close, then Requery on the closed recordset. Asks the position and BOF/EOF state a plain Requery leaves per type, whether it is refused for a type, and the closed-recordset error. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
